rules.statement: An indorsee for value cannot be confronted with defenses inconsistent with the terms of a memorandum or indorsement made on the face of the instrument by both the maker and the payee.
rules.supporting_quote: "Even, therefore, if as between the defendants inter se, the true position (unknown to the plaintiff) was that the note sued on ought to be regarded as having been discharged on 15th January 1948, that defence is not in my opinion .available as against the plaintiff."
